_comment: Fully commented example of .claude/loops/stack.config.json. Every `_comment_<key>` sibling documents the key next to it; the loader strips `_comment*` keys, so this file is itself loadable (LOOPS_STACK_CONFIG=.claude/loops/stack.config.example.json). NO SECRETS: config names the ENV VAR that holds a secret, never the value. Any key can be overridden per process with LOOPS_CFG__<PATH> (dots → double underscore, upper-cased), e.g. LOOPS_CFG__APP__URL=http://localhost:4000.
_comment_version: Schema version of this file. Bump only when keys change meaning.
_comment_project: Identity of the target app's repo as the loops see it.

project._comment_name: Short slug. Names the sandbox directory (../<name>-sandboxes/) and the default sandbox DB (<name>_<key>).
project.name: acme-shop
project._comment_ticket_key_pattern: Regex a ticket key must match before intake accepts it. A literal prefix (e.g. ^SHOP-[0-9]+$) is also what the file issue tracker allocates new keys with; a character class falls back to PROJ.
project._comment_default_branch: Branch PRs target and sandboxes branch from.
project._comment_branch_prefixes: Ticket type → branch prefix. sandbox.provision(key, ticket_type) builds <prefix><key>; unknown types use `fix`.
project._comment_protected_branch_patterns: fnmatch globs infra-ship refuses to push to or open a PR *from*. Pushing to one of these is a prod-lane action and needs a human.
project._comment_deploy_branch_patterns: Optional: globs whose merge triggers a deploy. Treated like protected branches by the ship gate.

_comment_app: Where the target app lives and how to reach it.

app._comment_repo_dir: Path to the app's git checkout, relative to THIS repo's root (or absolute). git-local vcs and git-worktree sandbox run git here.
app._comment_url: The app's base URL when started locally. The sandbox adapter derives per-sandbox URLs by shifting this port by slot*port_stride.
app._comment_api_url: Optional separate API origin (null when the app serves its own API). Shifted the same way for sandboxes.
app._comment_health_path: GET path that returns 2xx once the app is up; the recipe polls it after starting a sandbox.
app._comment_start_command: Command the recipe runs inside a sandbox dir to start the app. The adapter never starts it (Sandbox.started is always false).
app._comment_environments: Named environments. Names are yours (lab/uat/staging/prod…); skills take them as --env arguments. null url = that environment does not exist yet.

_comment_stack: How to build/lint/test the target app. null = the gate is skipped and *reported as skipped*, never silently passed.

stack._comment_languages: Informational; the conventions file carries the actual rules.
stack._comment_test_report: Where qa-regression finds machine-readable results after unit_test_command. format: junit.
stack._comment_conventions_file: The standards ruleset dev-pre-pr scans added lines with (format documented in examples/conventions/).
stack._comment_repo_guidelines_file: The target repo's own working agreement; dev-fix and dev-code-review read it for constraints.

_comment_adapters: One provider per role. `none` = role absent: a skill that needs it emits blocked with reason adapter-unavailable:<role>. Built-ins: issue_tracker[file], vcs_host[git-local], test_management[none only — bring a third-party provider], auth_provider[env-file], notifications[file], sandbox[git-worktree], evidence_store[local]. Third-party: "provider": "python.module.path:ClassName" (see lib/adapters/README.md → Adding a provider).

adapters._comment_issue_tracker: Here a third-party provider: the class `LinearTracker` in importable module `my_adapters.linear` (put my_adapters/ on PYTHONPATH or in lib/). Its config block is passed to the class verbatim. Secrets stay in env: api_key_env names the variable.
adapters._comment_vcs_host: git-local writes dry-run PRs to <evidence.root>/prs/<branch>.md. config.repo_dir overrides app.repo_dir; config.prs_dir overrides the output dir.
adapters._comment_test_management: Test-case manager role (list_cases, get_case, create_run, record_result, get_run). No built-in provider ships; plug one in as "module.path:ClassName" with *_env keys NAMING the env vars that hold its host and credentials. none → a skill that needs it stops with adapter-unavailable:test_management.
adapters._comment_analytics: Error-signal source for infra-prod-verify (query_error_signal, deployed_version). No built-in provider ships; none → prod-verify is blocked, which is the safe default.
adapters._comment_auth_provider: env-file reads env_file then local_env_file (later wins), then the process env. Variables: E2E_<ROLE>_USERNAME / E2E_<ROLE>_PASSWORD (+ any E2E_<ROLE>_* extra). login_hint tells the replay oracle how to sign in — a string, or a {role: hint} map with a `default`.

login_hint.default: Open /login, fill #email and #password, click 'Sign in', wait for /dashboard.
login_hint.admin: Same as default, then accept the admin MFA prompt via the E2E_ADMIN_TOTP_SECRET extra.

auth_provider._comment_config: roles is the canonical role vocabulary (lower-case); credentials resolve from `credential_env_pattern` with ROLE upper-cased (E2E_OWNER_USERNAME / E2E_OWNER_PASSWORD). `login` is the recipe the replay oracle renders to sign in. pre_auth none|header_token|sso_human_once is an optional perimeter in front of the app.

adapters._comment_ci_cd: build_status(ref), test_results(build_id), deploy_status(env). No built-in ships; none → skills that need CI evidence report it as unavailable.
adapters._comment_deploy: deployed_version(env), rollback_hint(env) — rollback itself is human-only; the adapter only returns instructions.
adapters._comment_sandbox: git-worktree: worktree at <repo_dir>/../<project.name>-sandboxes/<key> on branch <prefix><key>; slot 1..max_concurrent; ports = url port + slot*port_stride (port_base when the url has no port); registry <evidence.root>/sandboxes.json under an fcntl lock. db_clone_command (string or argv list) runs in the worktree with {key} {slot} {dir} {db}; db_drop_command runs on teardown. Optional: sandboxes_dir, registry_file, delete_branch_on_teardown.
adapters._comment_evidence_store: local keeps files under <evidence.root>/<key>/uploads/ and returns file:// urls. A remote store (S3, blob…) is a third-party provider.

_comment_evidence: root: the gitignored directory every run writes its artifacts under (intake/repro/fix/verify JSON, media, dry-run PRs, tickets, sandbox registry).
_comment_brain: config_file: the Postgres+pgvector brain pointer (DSN comes from that file or KB_DATABASE_URL — never defaulted).
_comment_limits_file: Per-loop budget/retry caps the recipe router enforces (R5).
_comment_models: Model ids by job. `rank` orders models weakest→strongest; a judge/verifier must rank >= the producer it grades. Defaults are current Claude ids; change freely.
_comment_deploy: prod_lane_branch_patterns: branches whose PUSH is a production deploy (refused while the brain's staging_only flag is true). Empty = no push deploys. tracks: independently deployed parts [{name, path_globs, version_endpoint, deployed_version_command, ci_deploy_status?}]. ci_deploy_status:true marks the track the ci_cd environment status describes (needed only with 2+ tracks).
_comment_browser: Documented prerequisites: playwright-cli drives the deterministic replay oracle; claude-in-chrome drives live exploration/recording.
_comment_runner: billing_posture subscription|metered decides how the R5 cap reads spend. claude_bin/config_dir are used by the scheduler templates.
_comment_integrations: Per-skill knobs for the release-AC, chatbot and UI-parity skills. Never tenant values: hosts and credentials come from env var NAMES in the adapter configs. release_ac.release_name_pattern: how the tracker names a release ("{name} {version}"); null = any release name containing the version.
_comment_personas_file: The persona pack qa-explore/qa-repro/qa-verify draw roles and habits from. Ship your own; the default is a neutral sample.
